cover.title:
API 静默失败时
强制校验把错答压到 1.7%
cover.dek: SilentGuard 在 harness 层做不变量检查，发现静默失败就强制弃答，错误回答从 74.0% 降到 1.7%。只发警告的做法，错误率仍有 70.1%。
cover.unit: 静默失败后的错误回答率
cover.title_en:
When an API fails silently,
enforced checks cut wrong answers to 1.7%
cover.dek_en: SilentGuard runs invariant checks in the harness and forces the agent to abstain when it spots a silent failure. Wrong answers fall from 74.0% to 1.7%, while a warning alone still leaves 70.1% wrong.
cover.unit_en: wrong answers after silent API failures
